## Biography

Doctor Gery appeared at Rainbow's End during the expedition's most precarious hour. Medical credentials, certainly. But the questions he asked were not clinical.

He examined the nanite-compound residue recovered from the derelict prototype carrier. He studied the strange filaments that had partially consumed crew bodies. And he listened — really listened — when Jasmina Halsey described what the Caretakers had shown her in witch-space. Gery's assessment was blunt: the technology involved operated on principles that modern medical science could not model, let alone treat. He recommended quarantine protocols stricter than anything DSS had planned. Then he helped implement them, working alongside Alessia Verdi and Jacky Hew in a makeshift lab that had no business processing material that dangerous.

Whether Gery was assigned by Deep Space Surveys, recruited by Ermitage's network, or simply showed up because someone needed to — the records do not say. Some specialists prefer it that way.
